ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed partners, ultimate beneficial owners, general partner controllers and designated signatories against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list (implemented in Bermuda by the UN Financial Sanctions Regulations), the UK Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) consolidated list, the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and non-SDN sanctions lists, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and Bermuda domestic sanctions orders. Enhanced Due Diligence must be applied to Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) as defined by the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 and the BMA AML/ATF Guidance Notes, including independent verification of identity, source of funds and continuous transaction monitoring by the licensed corporate services provider.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registrar of Companies e-Registry (Government of Bermuda online company and exempted partnership name reservation service, administered under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 and Companies Act 1981)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All proposed names must be rendered in the English language using Latin-script Roman characters; no foreign-script transliteration or diacritical marks are accepted. The name of an Exempted Limited Partnership must end with the statutory suffix 'Limited Partnership' or the abbreviation 'L.P.' as the final words, and must be sufficiently distinguishable from every registered, reserved or protected name in the Bermuda registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bermuda (requires specific consent of the Bermuda Government)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation may be extended before expiry by written application to the Registrar of Companies supported by a declaration of continuing intent to incorporate; each extension is granted for a further period of 30 days upon payment of the prescribed extension fee. Upon name rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, setting out grounds of distinctiveness and compliance with the statutory suffix and prohibited-token rules; the Registrar must issue a de novo written decision within 14 business days. A further refusal may be challenged by judicial review proceedings before the Supreme Court of Bermuda, which must be commenced within 21 days of the final administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office not permitted for the statutory registered office. The Exempted Limited Partnership must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at the premises of a Bermuda Monetary Authority-licensed corporate services provider; a PO Box or non-physical virtual address is unacceptable. Non-Bermudian administrative and manufacturing operations are permissible, but the Bermuda brass-plate office and licensed registered agent remain mandatory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated less than 5% annual likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection of the ELP's registered office by the Bermuda Monetary Authority, driven predominantly by BMA targeted supervisory inspections of licensed corporate services providers (sector-wide inspection frequency approximately 1–3% per annum). The probability of physical inspection at the non-Bermudian printing or fulfilment site is effectively nil because production assets have no Bermuda nexus.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015 (Bermuda), as amended, ss. 4-6, 8, 10 and 15 (registration, constitution, resident representative, registered office, and annual filing obligations); read with the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 and the Beneficial Ownership (Practical Aspects) Act 2018.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Corporate Services and Registry Department, Government of Bermuda, Hamilton, Bermuda.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an Exempted Limited Partnership (Form ELP-1), together with the Declaration of the General Partner and supporting consents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow deposit requirement for Bermuda exempted limited partnerships; capital quantum is fixed by the Limited Partnership Agreement and disclosed in the registration declaration, and may be satisfied in cash, property or services.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN RESOLUTION OF THE GENERAL PARTNER OF [NAME] L.P., a Bermuda exempted limited partnership: (1) RESOLVED, that the Limited Partnership Agreement dated ______, 20__ is adopted; (2) RESOLVED, that capital commitments of the initial Limited Partners in Schedule A are accepted and credited; (3) RESOLVED, that the registered office at [Hamilton address], Bermuda, and [Service Provider] as resident representative are appointed; (4) RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] are appointed Authorized Signatories to execute statutory filings, open banking and payment-rail accounts (Stripe, Authorize.Net), and bind the partnership for ordinary-course matters; (5) RESOLVED, that all officers and agents are authorized to implement the foregoing. DATED: ______, 20__.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (online name reservation via the Bermuda Registry e-Portal).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a preliminary availability search against the Bermuda Register of Companies. File a name reservation request in the approved format, listing a primary name ending with 'L.P.' or 'Limited Partnership' and two alternates. Names identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity, or implying Crown/government patronage or restricted activities, are refused. The Registrar issues a name reservation notice valid for a defined period, generally three months.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application form
General Partner identity particulars (passport or certificate of registration)
Brief statement of proposed principal activity (ISIC 3240 trading card publishing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused for similarity or restricted wording, promptly re-submit a revised application with the alternative names; an informal advisory opinion may be obtained from the Registry before formal filing. No fee refund applies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Certification of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda-licensed local counsel / notary public and the licensed corporate service provider (CSP).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The General Partner, or its authorized board or manager, executes the Limited Partnership Agreement, the Declaration of the General Partner and supporting consents. Where the General Partner is a corporate entity, attach its certificate of good standing, board resolution approving the ELP, and incumbency certificate. Signatures may be executed in counterparts; for non-Bermuda-incorporated general partners, notarization is not required at filing unless the Registry requests verified copies, but certified copies must be produced by the local CSP.
required_dossiers: Limited Partnership Agreement (governing ISIC 3240 publishing and payment-rail operations)
Declaration of the General Partner
Certificate of good standing or corporate extract of the corporate General Partner
Board resolution of the corporate General Partner approving formation
Incumbency certificate and specimen signatures
Registered office and resident representative consent letters (pre-signed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry disputes the sufficiency of certification, the local CSP must re-certify or re-notarize the offending pages; if the agreement conflicts with a mandatory provision of the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015, file an amending supplement before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Registration Application and Payment of Filing Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (in-person at the Government Administration Building, Hamilton, or via approved CSP submission).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form ELP-1, the Declaration of the General Partner, the consents of the resident representative and registered office, and the certified constitutive documents with the Registry. Pay the statutory filing fee in Bermuda dollars (at par with USD) by wire transfer or bank draft. The Registrar examines the application for compliance with the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015 and issues a Certificate of Registration upon approval.
required_dossiers: Form ELP-1 (application for registration)
Declaration of the General Partner
Limited Partnership Agreement (certified copy)
Consent to act of resident representative
Consent of registered office provider
Payment confirmation of the filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the Registrar issues a query or requisition, respond with amended pages or supplemental declarations within 21 days; failure to cure within the permitted period results in rejection and forfeiture of the filing fee, requiring a fresh application with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Protection Certificate Under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (exemption cleared through the Registrar of Companies).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for exempted undertaking status confirming that, until the protected period expiry (generally 2035, extendable to 2050), the ELP will not be subject to Bermuda income tax, capital gains tax, or a capital levy on profits or assets. Provide the partnership agreement and confirmation of offshore ownership and control. The certificate is delivered to the registered office and forms part of the ELP's permanent records.
required_dossiers: Application for exempted undertaking status (EUTPA form)
Certificate of Registration of the ELP
Certified copy of the Limited Partnership Agreement
Declaration confirming the ELP has no Bermuda-resident partners and does not conduct Bermuda-sourced business
Registered office acceptance endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax protection certificate is declined or conditioned, deliver a supplemental written undertaking and supporting evidence to the Ministry of Finance; a conditional certificate can be varied by further application to the Minister within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Compliance and Resident Service Configuration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda resident representative and CSP registered with the Registrar of Companies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Maintain the registered office and resident representative in Bermuda. Open partnership bank accounts and EMI payment-rail accounts (Stripe, Authorize.Net) in the ELP's name. File the beneficial ownership register notification with the Registry. File the annual declaration and pay the annual government fee. Keep the partnership and financial records at the registered office or as agreed in the Limited Partnership Agreement.
required_dossiers: Registered office confirmation of address
Resident representative agreement and filing confirmation
Beneficial ownership disclosure particulars (Bermuda BO register)
Partnership banking and payment-rail onboarding documents (KYB pack, partnership agreement, certificate, GP resolution)
Annual declaration calendar checklist
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual declaration is submitted late, apply for an informal extension before the due date; statutory late penalties accrue per day and can be compounded, so any delay must be cured by immediate electronic filing and a written waiver request with reasonable cause.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Bermuda Business Licensing Authority, Ministry of Economy and Labour; conditional jurisdiction of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) only if an on-island production facility is established.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Mandatory for Offshore ELP Pass-Through Operations: no Bermuda operating licence is required for the pure offshore publishing and trading ELP; if a physical cold-foil printing facility is later established, a Bermuda Business Licence (Category: Trading/Manufacturing) and any trade-specific permit would become mandatory.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Government of Bermuda.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Screening Level (Class 3) — a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is not triggered for a pure offshore publishing and trading ELP; a Preliminary Environmental Assessment would only be required upon physical establishment of a cold-foil holographic printing facility.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For any future production site: process wastewater trade effluent consent under Bermuda water legislation — pH 6-9, BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/l, suspended solids not exceeding 50 mg/l; VOC emissions from inks, foils and solvents not exceeding 50 mg C/Nm³ (BAT-based); hazardous waste (spent solvents, foil laminates, contaminated wipers) must be stored in secondary containment and removed by licensed waste carriers under a chain-of-custody manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable without physical premises; conditional requirements: Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service fire safety certificate (production and solvent storage risk classification), structural load certification for printing equipment, and workplace occupational safety clearance from the Bermuda Occupational Safety and Health Unit, including chemical agent inventory and temperature/humidity controls for holographic foil and raw stock.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Government — Registrar of Companies (Registry General, Ministry of Finance) for exempted partnership registration, annual Bermuda Government Business Fee and Economic Substance Act 2018 filings; Office of the Tax Commissioner for Payroll Tax and Social Insurance registration; Bermuda Customs Service (ASYCUDA World) for import/export duty. Central portal: https://www.gov.bm.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) File the Exempted Partnership application with the Registrar of Companies under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 (registered name, Bermuda registered office, general and limited partner particulars, exempted status declaration) and obtain the Certificate of Registration together with the Exempted Undertaking Tax Protection Certificate (Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966), which protects the ELP from any Bermuda taxes on income, gains, or dividends enacted before 2035. 2) Obtain the Registry entity reference number; Bermuda issues no general income-tax TIN because no income tax exists. 3) Apply through the Registrar for exchange-control 'non-resident' status so the foreign-owned ELP may freely hold and remit foreign currency. 4) If the ELP employs staff, register with the Office of the Tax Commissioner for a Payroll Tax Account Number and with the Department of Social Insurance. 5) File the annual business fee return and, if a 'relevant activity' (e.g., IP holding of card artwork/branding) is carried on, the Economic Substance Act 2018 declaration. No minimum capital and no Bermudian local partner are required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible — Bermuda statutory fiscally transparent partnership: no Bermuda entity-level income tax, corporation tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax on distributions; profits flow through to partners taxed only in their respective residence jurisdictions. Bermuda levies payroll tax solely where the ELP itself employs local staff. The Corporate Income Tax Act 2024 (15% OECD Pillar Two CIT) applies exclusively to in-scope multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least €750 million and is not engaged by this SME trading-card publisher.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None under Bermuda law (Bermuda has no check-the-box or entity-classification election because no income tax exists; ELP transparency is automatic). For U.S. federal tax purposes, the ELP may file Form 8832 to confirm partnership classification or affirmatively elect corporate status under Treas. Reg. §301.7701-3. UK hybrid mismatch rules (TIOPA 2010 Part 6A, OECD BEPS Action 2) require reconciliation of the ELP's Bermuda transparency with partner-jurisdiction treatment to prevent deduction/non-inclusion mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — Bermuda does not operate VAT, GST, or Sales and Use Tax. The only indirect tax of relevance is import Customs Duty under the Customs Tariff Act 1964 on goods entering Bermuda; exports are duty-free, and duty drawbacks apply to inputs incorporated in goods subsequently exported.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST threshold or indirect-tax registration mechanism exists in Bermuda. The ELP's registration obligations are: exempted partnership registration, annual Bermuda Government Business Fee (no revenue threshold), and, where importing or exporting, registration as a declarant with Bermuda Customs in ASYCUDA World.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, digital stamping, or real-time fiscal clearance mandate applies (no VAT system). Bermuda Customs operates ASYCUDA World as the single electronic window for automated import/export declarations, duty assessment, and e-payment; domestic B2B/B2C invoices are not subject to fiscal-authority reporting or clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — Bermuda has no VAT/GST and therefore no export zero-rating or VAT-refund mechanism. Exports of security-holographic cold-foil collectible trading cards are outside the scope of Bermuda taxation. Relevant reliefs are customs-based: (i) duty-free export from approved premises, (ii) import-duty drawback under the Customs Tariff Act 1964 where finished goods are exported within 12 months of importation of materials or machinery, and (iii) manufacturing duty relief for production inputs.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bermuda Customs Export Declaration lodged in ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Certificate of Origin (if required by the destination jurisdiction)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda Customs may conduct post-clearance audits under the Customs Tariff Act 1964 and the Customs Management and Duties Act 2010. False export declarations attract a fine of up to BD $25,000 and/or imprisonment, forfeiture of goods, and repayment of 100% of the duty relieved; drawback is clawed back where export does not occur within 12 months or goods are diverted to domestic consumption. Bermuda imposes no statutory FX-repatriation deadline; the 180-day period is the group treasury standard, and unsupported export proceeds may void customs reliefs. Where sales are routed via a UK/GB pan-European gateway, erroneous UK VAT zero-rating under VATA 1994 s.30(6) triggers HMRC assessment with default interest and penalties of up to 100% of the VAT.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), acting as Bermuda's central monetary authority and exchange control administrator; HM Treasury retains residual monetary sovereignty in respect of British Overseas Territories.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at 1:1 to the US dollar. Bermuda operates under the Exchange Control Act 1972 and subsidiary regulations but grants broad general permissions, making the domestic currency freely convertible for current account transactions and substantially convertible for capital account transactions. For the exempted limited partnership (ELP), non-resident status creates a 'deemed non-resident' exchange control posture, so profit remittances, capital distributions, and liquidation proceeds may be transferred without routine exchange control licences. The only practical hurdles are bank-level source-of-funds and AML verification. The regime is therefore fully convertible for the intended treasury model, with no material profit remittance gate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement and no mandatory conversion ratio for foreign currency earnings. Receipts from international collectible trading card sales may be retained in designated USD or other foreign currency accounts, or converted to BMD at the commercial bank's prevailing rate. For non-resident ELPs there is no obligation to force-sell export proceeds to the BMA or to a local authorised dealer, and no filing with the BMA is required unless an account is designated as a Bermuda Dollar Deposit Account or a specific transaction exceeds the bank's internal exchange control reporting threshold.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a secondary clearing rail, but low as a sole banking channel. Bermuda has no domestic electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime, and any foreign digital EMI soliciting deposits or executing payments on a recurring basis for a Bermuda-domiciled entity may trigger money service business classification under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999. The more practical route is to use a UK or EU authorised EMI (e.g. Wise Business, Airwallex, or a UK EMI) as an inbound collecting/concentration account for card platform payouts, then sweep via SWIFT MT103 to a tier-1 Bermuda bank for final settlement. Legal constraints include AML data-sharing clauses, KYC reliance limitations, and contractual ambiguity as to whether the EMI is carrying on cross-border business in Bermuda; the ELP must maintain the OS licence-compliant primary bank account as treasury spine.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda's AML/ATF framework and the Proceeds of Crime Act 1997 do not absolutely forbid remote onboarding, but the risk-based approach used by tier-1 Bermudian banks requires that at least one general partner or authorised signatory of the ELP either appear physically at a Bermuda branch or undergo an equivalent in-person verification before a qualified notary, consular officer, or an independent professional introduced by the bank. In practice, HSBC Bermuda and Butterfield permit remote onboarding for strict non-resident low-risk structures if the bank's digital KYC platform is used, a certified copy of the passport is apostilled, and a bank-confidential independent legal opinion from a Bermuda attorney is delivered. However, physical presence remains the default expectation for the vault-holding bank and is strongly recommended to avoid a 4-8 week rejection cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity of the Exempted Limited Partnership, particularly where limited partners hold indirect/non-titled interests through offshore vehicles.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Limited Partnership, executed partnership agreement, general partner register, register of limited partners (where legally available), Beneficial Ownership Act 2018 declaration form, full material ownership/control chain chart, certified identification for each ultimate beneficial owner, sworn declaration of non-resident status, and a Bermuda legal opinion on the pass-through classification and exclusion from exchange control resident status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume, low-value ecommerce revenue pattern from collectible trading card platform settlements via Stripe and Authorize.Net, creating a perception of commingled or unexplained micro-transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant platform settlement statements mapped by transaction ID, ecommerce sales dashboard export, website/domain ownership certificate, VAT and/or Irish/UK tax registration evidence where applicable, royalty and licensing contracts for intellectual property, historical card sales invoices, chargeback and refund policy documentation, and audited or internally-reviewed management accounts demonstrating the commercial substance of card publishing under ISIC 3240.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Overseas partner capital injection into the Bermuda ELP without physical Bermuda operational premises, triggering source-of-wealth and source-of-funds concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified bank statements showing the provenance of contributed funds for at least 12 months, personal/corporate tax returns of contributing partners, executed capital call notices and contribution schedules, participation confirmation letters, private placement memorandum or side letters, sworn affidavit of lawful source of funds, and a signed indemnity confirming that no Bermuda-resident beneficial interest exists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade disbursements to security holographic cold-foil printing suppliers, freight forwarders, and overseas customs brokers based in jurisdictions with perceived moderate AML/CFT weaknesses.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full KYC file on each counterparty including incorporation certificate and director register, signed vendor and procurement agreements, itemised purchase orders, invoices matched to bill of lading/air waybill, customs entry forms, proof of goods receipt and warehouse landing, SWIFT instruction history, batch-level negative media screening, and an enhanced due diligence file prepared under the bank's risk-based AML policy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital contributions are routed by SWIFT MT103 from the investing partner's registered bank account directly to the ELP's Bermuda tier-1 operational or capital escrow account. The beneficiary account name must exactly match the ELP name, the remitter must be the named limited/general partner, and the payment reference must include the partnership number, the capital call notice number, and the indicator 'CAP CONTRIBUTION - ISIC 3240'. The bank must receive a pre-authorised capital call resolution and the BMA general permission is available without individual filing. Purpose codes should reflect a capital account credit rather than trade in goods; in practice the remitter's bank uses a private investment/foreign direct investment purpose code such as 'Capital contribution to partnership' in line with SWIFT category P (P - Investments). Amounts above the bank's internal threshold (frequently US$100,000) require a certificate of incumbency, source-of-funds letter, and confirmation of the non-resident exchange control classification before value is applied.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments to printers, holographic foil suppliers, freight carriers, and customs agents are settled through SWIFT MT103 correspondent interbank transfers using open account terms. For supply contracts above US$250,000 or where the vendor insists on payment security, a commercial sight letter of credit (L/C) confirmed by a London or Bermudian correspondent bank is available; the ELP's USD/BMD account serves as the issuing/imbursement account. The clearing rails are SWIFT for cross-border wires, CHAPS/Fedwire for high-value same-day local clearing in USD/GBP, and the Automated Clearing House for low-value platform sweep settlements. No exchange control approval is required for outbound trade payments, provided the beneficiary is a genuine vendor and the bank's wire manual holds no compliance block. Merchant payouts from Stripe/Authorize.Net are consolidated into the ELP's dedicated merchant settlement account and then swept daily or weekly to the primary treasury account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: BMD/USD outright forwards with settlement in BMD or USD at a Bermuda authorised dealer, used to lock printing and logistics costs.
USD/EUR, USD/GBP and USD/CNH deliverable forwards with a UK/EU counterparty bank under an ISDA or long-form FX confirmation, accessible without BMA licensing for a non-resident ELP.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies where physical delivery is restricted, provided the ELP has no Bermuda resident beneficial owners and the counterparty is an international regulated bank.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for dual-currency working capital structures, executed under ISDA with credit support annex and limited to hedging actual card publishing, film-printing, and platform settlement exposures.
Bermuda-dollar/USD foreign exchange swaps for tenor-matched liquidity bridging between the transactional USD account and BMD escrow/operating accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempted Limited Partnership Annual Return (Registrar of Companies prescribed form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of each calendar year; newly registered exempted limited partnerships must make an initial filing within 30 days of registration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts default penalties rising from BMD 250 to BMD 500; continued non-compliance may lead to publication of a strike-off notice, removal from the Bermuda register, and automatic dissolution of the exempted limited partnership.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Declaration (Bermuda Economic Substance Requirements Act 2018)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies (Economic Substance Reporting Office), Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the end of the exempted limited partnership's fiscal year; a nil declaration is required if no relevant activity is undertaken in Bermuda.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file triggers a warning, followed by financial penalties of up to BMD 150,000; repeated non-compliance may result in strike-off and disqualification of the general partner from forming Bermuda entities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (accuracy confirmation and update of partnership interest transfers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Registrar of Companies (Beneficial Ownership Register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the annual return by 31 January; any transfer of a partnership interest must be notified to the Registrar within 30 days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is an offence carrying fines up to BMD 25,000 and a continuing daily penalty of BMD 500; the general partner may also be named in enforcement action by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No Bermuda statutory audit threshold applies to a non-resident, non-regulated exempted limited partnership. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only if the partnership is licensed or regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority, is a regulated investment fund, or otherwise holds a Bermuda regulatory licence; the collectible trading card publishing scope does not require a statutory audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Bermuda statutory accounting framework is prescribed for exempted limited partnerships. Financial statements, if prepared for management or banking purposes, normally follow IFRS; US GAAP may be adopted if the partnership agreement so provides and the relevant counterparties accept it.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The exempted limited partnership must maintain a beneficial ownership register and confirm its accuracy annually with the Registrar of Companies. Every transfer of a limited or general partnership interest requires an updated beneficial ownership filing within 30 days; the general partner is responsible for ensuring that the annual confirmation is filed by 31 January.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 10,000 if an independent certified audit is voluntarily elected or triggered; a non-regulated exempted limited partnership with no audit requirement can avoid this cost.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Bermuda imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax). For UK-resident corporate partners, the allocated ELP profits are taxed in the UK at 25% on profits exceeding GBP 250,000; 19% small-profits rate applies up to GBP 50,000 with marginal relief in between.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Bermuda's Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 (EUTPA) protects the ELP from future Bermuda income, capital, and gains taxes until 31 March 2035. Effective rate at entity level is nil. Pass-through classification allocates income directly to partners; no UK tax arises at the partnership level if the ELP has no UK permanent establishment, but a UK PE or UK-source trading activity would be assessed on the UK partners. For an active trading-cards printing business, the UK R&D expenditure credit (RDEC) or Patent Box (if applicable to the holographic security foil IP) may reduce the effective UK rate on allocated profits.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_note: Bermuda has no income tax, so loss carryforward is statutorily irrelevant; for UK-resident partners, trading losses of the ELP may be carried forward indefinitely under CTA 2010 s 45, subject to the GBP 5,000,000 profits offset restriction (50% of excess profits) for large companies.
